messages:
ravi: pushing a small hotfix: engine:quant-hotfix-20240405-01 to fix matmul fallback ordering. planning a quick 10% canary.
anya: window ok for 04:00-04:20 UTC? keeping it short.
sam: pin command `/deploy pin service=engine image=engine:quant-hotfix-20240405-01 ttl=3h reason="matmul fallback"`
deploy-bot: Pin created id=pin_20240405_01 target=engine image=engine:quant-hotfix-20240405-01 expires_in=3h pinned_by=sam
sre-ops: prewarm in us-west, will bump canary pool by +1 replica.
deploy-bot: Canary started rollout_id=roll_1719995555_c1 step=10% watch=6m auto-fallback=true
ravi: 6m check: p50 up +45% in eu-west; this looks off. pausing progression.
sre-ops: saw one pod hit slow kernel path, logs show fallback to scalar matmul; collecting liveness and kernel traces.
anya: abort progression and pin previous image back to 100% if we can't find quick fix.
sam: executing emergency rollback for canary group.
deploy-bot: Rollback executed: canary aborted, image restored to engine:previous for impacted nodes. Pin id=pin_20240405_01 retained for debugging (ttl=3h). Summary: canary stopped, p50 spike prevented broader impact.
ravi: will open a short incident note and assign to kernel-team. thanks for quick action.
anya: add a short release-note addendum: "reverted matmul change; investigation ongoing" and notif ops. :white_flag:
